description: Poll the health endpoint until Docker services are ready (retries every 2s for up to 60s)

actions.value: (async()=>{for(var i=0;i<30;i++){try{var r=await fetch('/api/health');if(r.ok){var j=await r.json();if(j.status==='ok'){window.__dockerReady=true;return}}}catch(e){}await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,2000))}throw new Error('Docker services not ready after 60s')})()
